<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#fffaf3">
  <title>For Aaniya ❤️</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --ink: #603f4a;
      --muted: #916f79;
      --paper: #fffaf3;
      --blush: #f6cdd4;
      --rose: #c56f83;
      --lilac: #ded3ef;
      --blue: #d8e7ee;
      --peach: #f7d7bd;
      --sage: #d8e3cf;
      --shadow: rgba(112, 72, 85, .17);
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: var(--ink);
      background: var(--paper);
      font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
    }

    button { font: inherit; }

    .app {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 100svh;
      overflow: hidden;
      isolation: isolate;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 12% 12%, rgba(222,211,239,.62), transparent 31%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 88% 15%, rgba(216,231,238,.68), transparent 29%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 10% 90%, rgba(247,215,189,.62), transparent 30%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 88% 88%, rgba(246,205,212,.6), transparent 32%),
        linear-gradient(145deg, #fffdf8, #fff8f2 48%, #fffaf5);
    }

    .floral-frame {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      background: url("data:image/webp;base64,") center / cover no-repeat;
      opacity: .72;
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      filter: saturate(.88) contrast(.96);
    }

    .scene {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 10;
      display: none;
      place-items: center;
      min-height: 100svh;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 72px);
    }

    .scene.active {
      display: grid;
      animation: sceneIn 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.78,.26,1) both;
    }

    .petal-layer, .tap-layer {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 30;
      overflow: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .petal {
      position: absolute;
      top: -40px;
      width: var(--size);
      height: calc(var(--size) * 1.35);
      border-radius: 80% 18% 72% 25%;
      background: var(--color);
      box-shadow: inset 2px 1px 3px rgba(255,255,255,.5);
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fall var(--duration) var(--delay) cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.5,1) infinite;
    }

    .tap-petal {
      position: fixed;
      width: 9px;
      height: 13px;
      border-radius: 80% 18% 72% 25%;
      background: var(--color);
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      animation: burst .9s ease-out forwards;
    }

    /* Gift */
    .gift-button {
      display: grid;
      justify-items: center;
      width: min(92vw, 620px);
      padding: 20px;
      border: 0;
      color: inherit;
      background: transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }

    .gift-button:focus-visible,
    .yes:focus-visible,
    .no:focus-visible,
    .continue-card:focus-visible,
    .cat-card:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(197,111,131,.45);
      outline-offset: 7px;
    }

    .gift {
      position: relative;
      width: clamp(190px, 28vw, 280px);
      height: clamp(210px, 30vw, 300px);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      animation: float 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .gift-shadow {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      bottom: 2px;
      width: 78%;
      height: 24px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(154,101,119,.13);
      filter: blur(13px);
      transform: translateX(-50%);
    }

    .gift-body, .gift-lid {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      border: 3px solid #9c5b6d;
      background:
        repeating-linear-gradient(112deg, rgba(255,255,255,.3) 0 3px, rgba(180,101,121,.06) 3px 8px),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #f9d6dc, #efb9c7);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(112,72,85,.13);
      transform: translateX(-50%);
    }

    .gift-body {
      bottom: 9px;
      width: 72%;
      height: 57%;
      border-radius: 5px 5px 14px 14px;
    }

    .gift-lid {
      top: 25%;
      z-index: 2;
      width: 86%;
      height: 25%;
      border-radius: 9px 9px 5px 5px;
      transform-origin: 72% 100%;
      transition: transform 1.45s cubic-bezier(.2,.72,.14,1), opacity 1.15s;
    }

    .ribbon {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0 auto 0 50%;
      width: 21%;
      border-inline: 2px solid rgba(156,91,109,.58);
      background: rgba(255,238,232,.5);
      transform: translateX(-50%);
    }

    .bow-loop, .bow-knot {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 3;
      border: 3px solid #9c5b6d;
      background: #f3bdca;
    }

    .bow-loop {
      bottom: 92%;
      width: 41%;
      height: 62%;
    }

    .bow-left { left: 11%; border-radius: 62% 48% 45% 55%; transform: rotate(16deg); }
    .bow-right { right: 11%; border-radius: 48% 62% 55% 45%; transform: rotate(-16deg); }

    .bow-knot {
      left: 50%;
      bottom: 91%;
      width: 20%;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border-radius: 45%;
      transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(7deg);
    }

    .gift.opening { animation: giftOpen 1.65s ease both; }
    .gift.opening .gift-lid { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-42%,-115%) rotate(18deg); }

    .eyebrow, .kicker {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: clamp(9px, 1.1vw, 12px);
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: .27em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .gift-title {
      margin-top: 10px;
      font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", cursive;
      font-size: clamp(35px, 6vw, 64px);
      letter-spacing: -.05em;
    }

    .gift-title b { color: var(--rose); font-weight: 400; }

    .tap-note {
      margin-top: 10px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font: italic 14px Georgia, serif;
    }

    /* Cards */
    .note-card, .question-card, .copy-card {
      border: 1px solid rgba(154,101,119,.18);
      background: rgba(255,253,249,.9);
      box-shadow: 0 28px 75px var(--shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }

    .note-card {
      width: min(88vw, 760px);
      padding: clamp(44px, 8vw, 90px) clamp(28px, 7vw, 82px);
      border-radius: 8px;
      text-align: center;
      animation: noteLife 5.2s ease both;
    }

    .note-card .heart { color: var(--rose); font: 30px Georgia, serif; }
    .note-card p { margin: 18px 0 0; font: clamp(25px,4vw,45px)/1.32 Georgia, serif; }
    .note-card .hand { color: var(--rose); font-family: "Segoe Print","Bradley Hand",cursive; font-size: clamp(21px,3.5vw,38px); }

    .question-card {
      position: relative;
      width: min(92vw, 800px);
      min-height: min(84svh, 670px);
      padding: clamp(38px,6vw,68px) clamp(25px,6vw,72px) 35px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 34px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .question-card h1 {
      margin: 22px auto 4px;
      max-width: 660px;
      font: 400 clamp(46px,8.5vw,92px)/.96 Georgia, serif;
      letter-spacing: -.055em;
    }

    .question-card h1 span {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 13px;
      color: var(--rose);
      font-family: "Segoe Print","Bradley Hand",cursive;
      font-size: .58em;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .try-no { margin: 16px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font: italic 13px Georgia,serif; }
    .answer-zone { position: relative; width: min(100%,600px); height: 190px; margin: 6px auto 0; }

    .yes, .no {
      position: absolute;
      top: 52%;
      min-width: 126px;
      padding: 15px 27px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .15em;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: left .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), top .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), transform .3s, box-shadow .3s, opacity .3s;
    }

    .yes {
      left: 34%;
      z-index: 4;
      border: 2px solid var(--rose);
      color: white;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg,#ce788c,#b75d75);
      box-shadow: 0 13px 27px rgba(183,93,117,.28);
      transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(var(--yes-scale,1));
    }

    .yes.centered { left: 50%; }
    .no {
      left: 70%;
      z-index: 3;
      border: 1px solid rgba(96,63,74,.25);
      color: var(--ink);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.82);
      box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(112,72,85,.09);
      transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
    }

    .no-message {
      min-height: 30px;
      margin: -15px auto 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font: clamp(14px,2vw,18px) "Segoe Print","Bradley Hand",cursive;
      opacity: .48;
    }

    /* Celebration and final */
    .split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(280px,.82fr) minmax(330px,1fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: clamp(38px,7vw,90px);
      width: min(1100px,92vw);
    }

    .polaroid {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      padding: clamp(10px,1.4vw,16px) clamp(10px,1.4vw,16px) clamp(48px,5vw,62px);
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: inherit;
      background: #fffdf9;
      box-shadow: 0 28px 65px rgba(112,72,85,.22);
      transform: rotate(-4deg);
    }

    .polaroid img {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      border-radius: 2px;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .continue-card, .cat-card {
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform .45s, box-shadow .45s;
      animation: photoIn 1.35s .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;
    }

    .continue-card:hover { transform: rotate(-2deg) translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 36px 80px rgba(112,72,85,.28); }
    .cat-card { transform: rotate(3.5deg); }
    .cat-card:hover, .cat-card.revealed { transform: rotate(1deg) translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 36px 80px rgba(112,72,85,.28); }

    .polaroid-label {
      position: absolute;
      right: 12px;
      bottom: 14px;
      left: 12px;
      color: var(--rose);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .24em;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .cat-label {
      position: absolute;
      right: 12px;
      bottom: 13px;
      left: 12px;
      color: var(--ink);
      font: clamp(12px,1.5vw,16px) "Segoe Print","Bradley Hand",cursive;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .cat-card.revealed .cat-label { color: var(--rose); }

    .copy-card {
      padding: clamp(34px,5vw,60px);
      border-radius: 28px;
    }

    .copy-card p {
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      font: clamp(24px,3.7vw,48px)/1.05 Georgia,serif;
    }

    .copy-card .marry {
      margin-top: 27px;
      color: var(--rose);
      font-family: "Segoe Print","Bradley Hand",cursive;
      font-size: clamp(24px,3.6vw,44px);
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .final-copy h2 {
      margin: 18px 0 21px;
      color: var(--rose);
      font: 400 clamp(68px,11vw,128px)/.86 Georgia,serif;
      letter-spacing: -.065em;
    }

    .final-copy p {
      max-width: 390px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font: clamp(15px,2vw,20px)/1.55 "Segoe Print","Bradley Hand",cursive;
    }

    @keyframes sceneIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(.985); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    }

    @keyframes float {
      0%,100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-.7deg); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-10px) rotate(.7deg); }
    }

    @keyframes giftOpen {
      0% { transform: scale(1); }
      45% { transform: scale(1.08); }
      100% { transform: scale(.96); opacity: 0; }
    }

    @keyframes noteLife {
      0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(15px) scale(.98); }
      14%,82% { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
      100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); }
    }

    @keyframes photoIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-8deg) translateY(35px) scale(.9); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(-4deg); }
    }

    @keyframes fall {
      0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0,-30px,0) rotate(0); }
      8% { opacity: .85; }
      88% { opacity: .72; }
      100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(var(--drift),112svh,0) rotate(var(--turn)); }
    }

    @keyframes burst {
      from { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(var(--angle)) translateX(0) scale(.6); }
      to { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(var(--angle)) translateX(var(--distance)) scale(1.2); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 760px) {
      .scene { padding: 24px 18px 42px; }
      .floral-frame { opacity: .58; }
      .gift { width: 205px; height: 224px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
      .question-card { width: min(94vw,560px); min-height: min(82svh,625px); padding: 42px 18px 24px; }
      .question-card h1 { font-size: clamp(45px,14vw,68px); }
      .yes, .no { min-width: 106px; padding: 14px 20px; }
      .yes { left: 31%; }

      .split {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 22px;
        width: min(90vw,470px);
      }

      .continue-card { justify-self: center; width: min(56vw,250px); }
      .copy-card { padding: 25px; text-align: center; }
      .copy-card p { font-size: clamp(21px,6.3vw,30px); }
      .copy-card .marry { margin-top: 18px; font-size: clamp(21px,6vw,29px); }

      .final-copy { text-align: center; }
      .final-copy h2 { margin: 12px 0 14px; font-size: clamp(60px,20vw,92px); }
      .final-copy p { margin-inline: auto; font-size: 14px; }
      .cat-card { justify-self: center; width: min(58vw,250px); padding-bottom: 68px; }
      .cat-label { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.25; }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation-duration: .01ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        transition-duration: .01ms !important;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main class="app" id="app">
    <div class="floral-frame" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="petal-layer" id="petals" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="tap-layer" id="tapPetals" aria-hidden="true"></div>

    <section class="scene active" id="giftScene" aria-labelledby="giftTitle">
      <button class="gift-button" id="giftButton" type="button" aria-label="Open Aaniya's gift">
        <span class="gift" id="gift">
          <span class="gift-shadow"></span>
          <span class="gift-body"><span class="ribbon"></span></span>
          <span class="gift-lid">
            <span class="ribbon"></span>
            <span class="bow-loop bow-left"></span>
            <span class="bow-loop bow-right"></span>
            <span class="bow-knot"></span>
          </span>
        </span>
        <span class="eyebrow">A LITTLE SOMETHING</span>
        <span class="gift-title" id="giftTitle">For Aaniya <b>♡</b></span>
        <span class="tap-note" id="tapNote">tap to open</span>
      </button>
    </section>

    <section class="scene" id="introScene" aria-live="polite">
      <div class="note-card">
        <div class="heart">♡</div>
        <p>Since I never got to ask you myself…</p>
        <p class="hand">it’s only right that I do it properly.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="scene" id="questionScene" aria-labelledby="questionTitle">
      <div class="question-card">
        <span class="kicker">ONE VERY IMPORTANT QUESTION</span>
        <h1 id="questionTitle"><span>Aaniya,</span>will you marry me?</h1>
        <p class="try-no">(try clicking no)</p>
        <div class="answer-zone">
          <button class="yes" id="yesButton" type="button">YES ♥</button>
          <button class="no" id="noButton" type="button" aria-label="No — although this button may move">NO</button>
        </div>
        <div class="no-message" id="noMessage" aria-live="polite">Choose carefully, babe.</div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="scene" id="celebrationScene" aria-live="polite">
      <div class="split">
        <button class="polaroid continue-card" id="continueButton" type="button" aria-label="Continue to one last message">
          <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="A large elegant bouquet of pastel flowers">
          <span class="polaroid-label">CLICK HERE</span>
        </button>
        <div class="copy-card">
          <p>NO TAKE BACKS.</p>
          <p>WE ARE LOCKED.</p>
          <p class="marry">GIRL, IMMA SO MARRY YOU. 💍</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="scene" id="finalScene" aria-labelledby="finalTitle">
      <div class="split">
        <div class="final-copy">
          <span class="kicker">PS — IN CASE YOU FORGOT…</span>
          <h2 id="finalTitle">I miss you.</h2>
          <p>He was instructed to make sure you got the message.</p>
        </div>
        <button class="polaroid cat-card" id="catButton" type="button" aria-label="Tap the cat for one last message">
          <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="A very cute fluffy kitten curled on a soft blanket">
          <span class="cat-label" id="catLabel">tap the cat</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <script>
    (() => {
      const scenes = {
        gift: document.getElementById("giftScene"),
        intro: document.getElementById("introScene"),
        question: document.getElementById("questionScene"),
        celebration: document.getElementById("celebrationScene"),
        final: document.getElementById("finalScene")
      };

      const noMessages = [
        "Wrong button, babe.",
        "Nice try. Now click yes.",
        "The NO moved away. Take the hint.",
        "The audacity 😭",
        "That button doesn’t work, unfortunately.",
        "You’re already engaged to me, remember?",
        "Okay, enough games. Click YES.",
        "NO has officially left the chat."
      ];

      const noPositions = [
        [77,28], [24,76], [80,76], [18,28],
        [74,52], [38,20], [61,80], [84,22]
      ];

      const colors = ["#efbdc8","#d7c7e9","#bcd7e4","#f1d39f","#d7e2ce"];
      const petalLayer = document.getElementById("petals");
      const tapLayer = document.getElementById("tapPetals");
      const noButton = document.getElementById("noButton");
      const yesButton = document.getElementById("yesButton");
      const noMessage = document.getElementById("noMessage");
      let noAttempts = 0;
      let currentScene = "gift";

      function show(name) {
        Object.values(scenes).forEach(scene => scene.classList.remove("active"));
        scenes[name].classList.add("active");
        currentScene = name;
        if (name !== "gift") startPetals(name === "celebration" || name === "final");
      }

      function startPetals(intense = false) {
        petalLayer.replaceChildren();
        const count = intense ? 54 : 30;
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          const petal = document.createElement("span");
          petal.className = "petal";
          petal.style.left = `${(i * 37 + 11) % 101}%`;
          petal.style.setProperty("--size", `${7 + (i * 7) % 9}px`);
          petal.style.setProperty("--color", colors[i % colors.length]);
          petal.style.setProperty("--delay", `${((i * 17) % 31) / 10}s`);
          petal.style.setProperty("--duration", `${(intense ? 6.2 : 7.4) + ((i * 13) % 43) / 10}s`);
          petal.style.setProperty("--drift", `${-70 + (i * 29) % 141}px`);
          petal.style.setProperty("--turn", `${180 + (i * 43) % 520}deg`);
          petalLayer.appendChild(petal);
        }
      }

      function tapBurst(x, y) {
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
          const petal = document.createElement("span");
          petal.className = "tap-petal";
          petal.style.left = `${x}px`;
          petal.style.top = `${y}px`;
          petal.style.setProperty("--color", colors[i % colors.length]);
          petal.style.setProperty("--angle", `${i * 60 - 90}deg`);
          petal.style.setProperty("--distance", `${32 + (i % 3) * 13}px`);
          tapLayer.appendChild(petal);
          setTimeout(() => petal.remove(), 950);
        }
      }

      function moveNo() {
        if (!noButton.isConnected || noAttempts >= noMessages.length) return;
        const [x, y] = noPositions[noAttempts];
        noButton.style.left = `${x}%`;
        noButton.style.top = `${y}%`;
        noMessage.textContent = noMessages[noAttempts];
        noAttempts += 1;
        yesButton.style.setProperty("--yes-scale", Math.min(1 + noAttempts * .055, 1.4));
        if (noAttempts === noMessages.length) {
          setTimeout(() => {
            noButton.remove();
            yesButton.classList.add("centered");
          }, 650);
        }
      }

      document.getElementById("app").addEventListener("pointerdown", event => tapBurst(event.clientX, event.clientY));

      document.getElementById("giftButton").addEventListener("click", () => {
        const gift = document.getElementById("gift");
        gift.classList.add("opening");
        document.getElementById("tapNote").textContent = "opening…";
        startPetals(false);
        setTimeout(() => {
          show("intro");
          setTimeout(() => show("question"), 5200);
        }, 1700);
      }, { once: true });

      noButton.addEventListener("pointerenter", event => {
        if (event.pointerType === "mouse") moveNo();
      });
      noButton.addEventListener("click", event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        moveNo();
      });

      yesButton.addEventListener("click", () => show("celebration"));
      document.getElementById("continueButton").addEventListener("click", () => show("final"));
      document.getElementById("catButton").addEventListener("click", event => {
        event.currentTarget.classList.add("revealed");
        document.getElementById("catLabel").textContent = "Oh yes—if it wasn’t obvious, I still miss you. ♡";
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
